sections.title: Tree and leaves
sections.text: This catalogue entry is Populus tremula, the European aspen. It is a fast-growing deciduous tree reaching about 25 m. Rounded adult leaves, usually 5–7 cm long, tremble in the wind on flattened petioles; juvenile leaves are more pointed.

sections.title: Catkins and habitat
sections.text: Male and female catkins appear before the leaves. The species is native across much of northern and central Europe and often spreads by root suckers.

sections.title: Comparison
sections.text: Unlike black poplar, P. nigra, the aspen has rounded, fluttering adult leaves and typically grows as a pioneer tree.
